Here's the exact error back from the system:

> **"Blocked: step 1 (Identify and label the two blue cables) did not pass the check. The blue cables are visible but neither has a tape label with 'Cable A' or 'Cable B' written on it. Fix that, send a new photo, and we will move on."**

Sorry — I can't get past this one until the labels are on! Just add the tape labels, snap a quick photo, and we'll be on our way. 📸
